title: Don't Say "I'm Busy" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't just say "I'm busy". Say one of these instead:
• I'm tied up right now. It means not now.
• I have my hands full. It sounds less rude.
• With friends: I've got a lot on my plate!
